title: pulci state
description: Schema for state objects emitted by pulci. The canonical form is `.pulci/state.json` written by `pulci start`. `pulci status --json` additionally enriches the object with daemon_status, daemon_heartbeat_at, and age — those three are not present in the on-disk file but are part of the CLI output contract.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Will be bumped on breaking changes.

state_version.description: Monotonically increasing counter incremented on every atomic write. Agents use this with wait_for_file/since_version in pulci_status to detect new results without polling.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last state.json write.

checks_run.description: Monotonic counter incremented on every check pass since first daemon run, persisted across restarts.

stale.description: True when resolved tools changed since last daemon start.

diagnostics.description: Live aggregated diagnostics across every file the daemon has observed. Editing one file updates only that file's entries; the rest stay as they were last checked. Files deleted from disk are removed from the aggregate.

tool.description: Adapter name: ruff, ty, pytest, etc.

file.description: Relative path to the file containing the diagnostic.

tools.description: Resolved tool metadata for each enabled adapter.

path.description: Absolute path if source is local-venv or system-path.

tool_errors.description: Non-diagnostic hook failures (timeout, signal kill, parser crash). When non-empty, the listed tools produced no verdict for this check pass — agents should not treat absence of diagnostics from those tools as success.

daemon_status.description: CLI-only field injected by `pulci status --json`, derived from heartbeat age. Not present in the on-disk `.pulci/state.json`.

daemon_heartbeat_at.description: CLI-only field injected by `pulci status --json`: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last heartbeat write.

age.description: CLI-only field injected by `pulci status --json`: relative ages computed at status-call time.
